blocks.title: Osmoregulation
blocks.text: Osmoregulation jism ki rutoobaton mein pani aur ghulne wale madde ka tawazun qaim rakhna hai, ta ke woh na bohat patli hon na bohat gaarhi.

Yeh khoon ka durust dabao, aaza ke durust kaam aur metabolism ke qaboo ke liye zaroori hai. Yaad rahe ke osmosis jhilli ke paar pani ki diffusion hai, zyada patle (hypotonic) mahlool se kam patle (hypertonic) mahlool ki taraf, aur osmotic pressure mahlool ki osmosis se pani lene ki salahiyat ka paimana hai.

blocks.prompt: Osmosis se pani kis taraf jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Zyada patle (hypotonic) mahlool se zyada gaarhe (hypertonic) mahlool ki taraf.

items: Osmoregulation jism ki rutoobaton mein pani aur madde ka tawazun rakhta hai; pani osmosis se gaarhi taraf jata hai.
